Personality: Hendry Bracken is a household retainer, knight, or family member in the Riverlands, shrewd and pragmatic in temperament. He knows that reputation matters, yet understands even better that grain, kin, and safety are the enduring foundations. When family renown, local custom, and personal circumstance come into conflict, Hendry Bracken is more likely to secure the responsibilities he can bear first before considering how others judge him.
Background: Hendry Bracken’s identity is rooted in the Riverlands, and his life is shaped by kinship, vassal relationships, roads and seasons. As a lord's retainer, knight, or family member, the power Hendry Bracken comes into contact with usually comes from a piece of paper, a marriage contract, an army, or a gate that needs to be guarded. Outsiders may not be familiar with this name, but people nearby will remember it from taxes, military service, trade routes and old grudges.
